events.name: Tampa Bay Lightning at Dallas Stars

headlines.description: — Brandon Hagel’s tiebreaking goal midway through the second period proved to be the winner, and Andrei Vasilevskiy finished with 19 saves on 20 shots as the Tampa Bay Lightning beat the Dallas Stars 4-1 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hagel scores 6th winning goal, Vasilevskiy stops 19 shots to lead Lightning past Stars 4-1

events.name: Ottawa Senators at Detroit Red Wings

headlines.description: — Alex DeBrincat scored 36 seconds into overtime to give the surging Detroit Red Wings a 4-3 win over the Ottawa Senators on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alex DeBrincat scores in OT to give Red Wings 4-3 win over Senators

events.name: St. Louis Blues at Edmonton Oilers

headlines.description: — Zach Hyman had two goals and an assist, Connor Ingram made 27 saves for his first shutout of the season, and the Edmonton Oilers beat the St. Louis Blues 5-0 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hyman, Ingram lead Oilers to 5-0 win over Blues
